„trockenem Haar" establishes application to dry hair as a generally permitted use → dry_hair (§7.13 stage table).
No named heat tool and no direction positioning the application before heat styling → pre_heat is not transcribed. No finishing-step direction → post_style is not transcribed.

tail_marker.plausibility_test: §3.1.1 clause 5 (T16): every ingredient establishing COND/WT — ISOPROPYL MYRISTATE r2, DIMETHICONE r3, AMODIMETHICONE r4, RICINUS COMMUNIS SEED OIL r7 — outranks the marker at r13. The marker sits after the architecture it is supposed to bound ⇒ plausible; clauses 1 and 3 govern normally and no `tail_marker_implausible` note is warranted.
tail_marker.vacuity_test: §3.1.1 clause 6 (T17 H1): ingredients at or below r13 include BEHENTRIMONIUM CHLORIDE r14, TRIDECETH-6 r15, POLYQUATERNIUM-4 r16, PANTHENOL r21, CARBOMER r24, POTATO STARCH MODIFIED r26 and CETRIMONIUM CHLORIDE r27 — none of which is a capped material, a fragrance/allergen declaration or a colourant. The tail is not vacuous; `tail_marker_vacuous` does not fire.
tail_marker.marker_eligibility_note: BENZYL ALCOHOL (r20) is also marker-eligible as a preservative, but PHENOXYETHANOL is the FIRST capped ingredient in the list and is therefore the marker (§3.1.1). The declared EU allergen block is not marker-eligible (§3.1.1, T17 H2).
tail_marker.heuristic_limitation: §3.1.1 mandatory limit 1: the marker ingredient and its rank are recorded because the anchor decisions that lean on it (PERS's POLYQUATERNIUM-4 read, R2's below-tail test, the L9 above-tail test) turn on it. §17.14 (unvalidated heuristic) and §17.18 (variance across list lengths) are inherited. It is a within-list marker only and is never compared across products (§3.1.1 limit 5).

conditioning_potential.anchor: §7.2 `moderate` — one coherent conditioning route present as architecture, without a full LGN pair: a persistent silicone/emollient package (DIMETHICONE r3 + AMODIMETHICONE r4; ISOPROPYL MYRISTATE r2; RICINUS COMMUNIS SEED OIL r7), all above the r13 marker.

RICINUS COMMUNIS SEED OIL / CASTOR SEED OIL (r7, L3 rich / low-spreading band)

supporting_signals: BEHENTRIMONIUM CHLORIDE r14 and CETRIMONIUM CHLORIDE r27 are monomeric long-chain quats sitting at or below the marker; they are present (§3.1.1 limit 4: the marker never creates absence) but cannot be read as architecture on rank, so they do not add a further independent route for the `high` anchor.
POLYQUATERNIUM-4 r16 and HYDROXYPROPYL GUAR r8: the latter is the non-cationised guar derivative, not Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride, so it is not an L1 cationic-polymer route at all.

On COND this is materially harmless — both demoted captures also land on `moderate` (mueller.de on the same silicone/emollient package; loreal-paris.de on an emollient + cationised-protein film route) — so the value is convergent across every capture on file, and confidence is held one step below the ceiling for the source situation rather than for the value.
No C1 back-of-pack photo has been obtained; the formula of record rests on three converging C3/T3 web sources, not on a shelf unit (packet remaining_gap).
conditioning_potential.threshold_reasoning: Clears `moderate` because one coherent conditioning route — a persistent silicone/emollient package — is present as architecture above the tail. Does not clear `high`: the `high` anchor requires an LGN pair present above the tail plus a further independent lubrication route, and the formula of record carries NO long-chain fatty alcohol anywhere (no Cetearyl/Cetyl/Stearyl/Behenyl/Myristyl/Arachidyl Alcohol), so an LGN pair cannot be formed under §3.1.2 at any rank. Does not fall to `low`: `low` requires only a short-chain quat or a water/glycol solution with no persistent non-volatile above the tail, and four persistent non-volatiles sit above it.
limitations: Ceiling moderately high (§7.2); held at `moderate` for the residual source situation, not for the architecture read.
Tail-marker heuristic, unvalidated (§3.1.1 mandatory limit 1, §17.14, §17.18).
G4: no concentration, ratio, pH, viscosity grade or deposited amount is inferred; Dimethicone at 5 cSt and at 1,000,000 cSt read identically (SR §C.2).

weight_residue_potential.anchor: §7.5 `high` — "two or more persistent non-volatile families with at least one rich/low-spreading band member". Three persistent non-volatile families are present as architecture above the r13 marker: the L3 dry-feel ester ISOPROPYL MYRISTATE r2; the L2 persistent silicone family DIMETHICONE r3 + AMODIMETHICONE r4; and the L3 rich/low-spreading band member RICINUS COMMUNIS SEED OIL / CASTOR SEED OIL r7. Castor oil is an enumerated member of the L3 rich band (§5), so the closed rich-band enumeration (§7.5) is satisfied by name rather than by convention.
weight_residue_potential.multi_family_row_check: The multi-family `moderate` row (§7.5, R13) is NOT the applicable row: it requires two or more persistent families with NONE of them a rich/low-spreading band member. Castor oil is a rich-band member, so the `high` anchor governs and the multi-family row's mandatory counter-signal is not the note this record carries.
weight_residue_potential.lgn_check: No LGN pair (no long-chain fatty alcohol anywhere in the formula of record), so the `high` value rests solely on the multi-family-plus-rich-band limb of the anchor, not on the LGN limb.

weight_conflict_tag.condition_failed: §10.1.2 condition 2. Condition 1 IS met (WT resolved to `high` from formula alone, E2), but no C1/C2 intended-finish or positioning statement materially contradicts it. The only C2 source (loreal-paris.de „Produktdetails") is a repair / anti-split / moisture / shine / styling-ease paragraph and asserts no light finish — no „beschwert nicht", „leicht", „ohne zu beschweren", „federleicht" or equivalent. The mueller.de bullet list is C3 and could never trigger the tag (§10.1.2 condition 2, G13). Condition 4 would also fail: silence about weight is not a contradiction. The tag is therefore declined and the failed condition is named, as §10.1.2's determinism clause requires.

counter_signals: Residual source noise: the demoted loreal-paris.de capture would read `moderate` rather than `high` — on that list the volatile CYCLOPENTASILOXANE r2 contributes nothing (M6), and PEG/PPG-17/18 DIMETHICONE r14, DIMETHICONOL r18 and AMODIMETHICONE r24 all sit below its own r13 marker, leaving castor oil as effectively the only persistent family above the tail. The demoted mueller.de capture reads `high` exactly as the primary does. Confidence is held at `moderate` for this residual, not raised to the moderately-high the ceiling would otherwise permit.
§17.1: dose is an unmeasured term in residue load ≈ dose × non-volatile fraction × (1 − transfer/removal); the architecture gives an ordinal read on the middle term only.
weight_residue_potential.threshold_reasoning: Clears `high` because the anchor's rich-band limb is satisfied by an enumerated member (castor oil, r7) alongside two further persistent non-volatile families, all above the marker. Does not stop at `moderate`: the single-family limb describes exactly one persistent family, and the multi-family limb explicitly requires NO rich-band member — both are excluded on the same observation. Does not fall to `low`: `low` requires no persistent non-volatile family above the tail. `unknown` is not taken: the non-volatile architecture of the formula of record is fully readable above the tail, and the residual outliers are documented source noise around an adjudicated primary, not an unresolvable conflict about this record's own architecture.
limitations: Ceiling moderate; it may rise to moderately high only when the architecture read resolves to a definite class AND the non-volatile architecture is fully readable above the tail (§7.5). Both hold, but confidence is held at `moderate` for the residual source situation rather than raised.
G9: no part of this read comes from the presentation form or the architecture read, in either direction (FS-1, FS-2, FS-17, FS-18).

§7.5 known judgment call: no evidence establishes a residue load at which fine hair reads as limp (SR §M.11, §17.11). The `caution` this value produces for fine hair in §10.3 is a product judgment call, not a derived scientific constant.
§17.15: unenumerated liquid vegetable oils are read in the medium band by convention — not load-bearing here, since castor oil is enumerated by name.

persistence_removal_class.anchor: §7.6 `ph_dependent_cationic` — AMODIMETHICONE r4, present as architecture above the r13 marker, is the highest ordinal class present as architecture. Ordinal rule: highest class present as architecture wins; the lower classes are recorded as supporting.
supporting_classes_recorded: `neutral_non_volatile`: DIMETHICONE r3 (persistent silicone), ISOPROPYL MYRISTATE r2 (ester), RICINUS COMMUNIS SEED OIL r7 (oil) — all above the marker.
`volatile_or_water_soluble`: no volatile carrier is present at all on the formula of record (no cyclomethicone, no isododecane), so M6 contributes nothing here.
below_marker_notes: POLYQUATERNIUM-4 sits at r16, BELOW the r13 marker. It is a polymeric quat that would otherwise qualify `permanent_cationic` under §7.6's enumerated-by-INCI-name rule. §3.1.1 clause 1 (rank is the single deterministic prong) denies it presence as architecture; §3.1.1 clause 3 therefore requires the dimension to take its rank-supported value, the below-marker note to be recorded, and the record to route to human review. The marker is plausible (clause 5) and non-vacuous (clause 6), so clauses 1 and 3 govern unmodified.
BEHENTRIMONIUM CHLORIDE r14 and CETRIMONIUM CHLORIDE r27 are monomeric long-chain quats, both below the marker.
persistence_removal_class.monomeric_quat_note: §7.6's mandatory monomeric-quat note is NOT the governing note on this record: a monomeric long-chain quat is not the dominant persistent species — AMODIMETHICONE r4, above the marker, is. The monomeric quats are recorded as present-but-below-marker observations instead, and the record does not place a monomeric quat in `neutral_non_volatile` as its class, so the note's precondition is absent.
counter_signals: §3.1.1 clause 4, FS-20: strict rank under-states persistence on a below-marker polymeric quat (POLYQUATERNIUM-4 r16), which under-warns on buildup. That risk is carried to a human by the review route, never into a projected field. Note that on this record the buildup caution fires anyway on §8.5's widened WT limb, so the under-warning does not reach the user.

Residual source noise: on the demoted loreal-paris.de capture, HYDROXYPROPYLTRIMONIUM HYDROLYZED WHEAT PROTEIN r12 sits above that capture's own r13 marker and would reach `permanent_cationic` — a two-class, `moderate`-vs-`high` divergence. That species is absent from the formula of record. Confidence is lowered to `low` for this residual together with the marker dependence, rather than the value being blanked.

The codecheck.info leg of the three-source convergence was captured via an AI-mediated fetch-and-summarize tool (packet-flagged lower extraction fidelity); the rossmann.de and parfumdreams.de legs were not, and all three returned the identical list in identical order.
persistence_removal_class.threshold_reasoning: `permanent_cationic` is not reached: the only polymeric quat (POLYQUATERNIUM-4 r16) and both monomeric quats sit at or below the marker, and no silicone quat or cationised protein is present on the formula of record. `neutral_non_volatile` is not taken because a higher class — the pH-dependent amino silicone AMODIMETHICONE — IS present as architecture above the marker, and the ordinal rule takes the highest such class. `unknown` is not taken: the persistent architecture of the formula of record is readable.
limitations: Ceiling low–moderate (§7.6) ⇒ capped at `moderate`; held one step lower at `low` for marker dependence plus the residual outlier that would move the class.
Tail-marker heuristic (§3.1.1 mandatory limit 1, §17.14, §17.18).
G11: no duration, wash count, applications-to-buildup figure or clarification schedule is stated. The class is a mechanism ordering, not a duration.
§7.6 banned numbers: none of the circulating removal percentages is used. §17.2: no finished-product accumulation study exists.
FS-12: amodimethicone's rinse-off selectivity argument does not transfer to leave-on and is not relied on (G8).

hold_route_state.anchor: §7.7 `none` — no fixative-class L5 polymer is present anywhere on the formula of record.
supporting_signals: CARBOMER r24, HYDROXYPROPYL GUAR r8 and POTATO STARCH MODIFIED r26 plausibly serve bottle viscosity and are L5 rheology exclusions (§5, FS-25); they are not a hold route.
POLYQUATERNIUM-4 is a cellulose-based cationic polymer, not a vinyl/acrylate fixative-class film former; it is read with L1/PERS, never with L5 (FS-9).
The frozen claims[] carries no manufacturer hold statement at any tier, so §7.7/T7's capture clause has nothing to record and the §14 `manufacturer_hold_level` trigger does not fire.
hold_route_state.threshold_reasoning: `incidental_film` and `meaningful_hold_route` both require a fixative-class polymer to be present at all; none is. All three captures on file agree completely on this point, so the residual source situation does not reach HOLD at all — this is the one dimension the amendment could not have moved.

G3: the hold read and the conditioning read are different mechanisms and neither raises the other.

heat_protection_evidence_state.claim_authority: §2.4.1 / G13. The frozen claims[] carries one C2 entry (loreal-paris.de, the manufacturer's own German-market product page — claim-creating) whose text is a repair / anti-split / moisture / shine / styling-ease paragraph with no heat statement, and one C3 entry (mueller.de, exact-GTIN German retailer — corroborating only, never claim-creating) which also carries none. The packet's claims_search_note records that both pages were actively checked for heat-protection, UV-protection, hold and anti-frizz claims and that none was found. §2.4 claim-capture rule 2's "not captured vs does not exist" distinction resolves to DOES NOT EXIST here: a C2 source was located and read, and it carries no heat claim. No C1 pack capture exists and no C2_cross_market_verified claim is on file (§2.4.1 rule 7's identity-plus-corroboration exception is not invoked — there is no non-German manufacturer heat claim to admit).
heat_protection_evidence_state.claim_authority_gap_check: The `claim_authority_gap` trigger (§14, §2.4.1 rule 1) does NOT fire. It exists for the case where a claim appears only in retailer copy and no C1/C2 source could be located, so a human can decide whether the manufacturer source was simply not found. Here the manufacturer source WAS found and read, and no retailer heat copy exists either — there is nothing for a human to reconcile on authority. The correct routing for this record's shape is T17's mirror trigger, `l9_member_without_claim`, which does fire.
l9_members_present: HYDROLYZED WHEAT PROTEIN r10 — a member of the closed L9 list (McMullen & Jachowicz 1998), present ABOVE the r13 tail marker.
l9_non_members_recorded: HYDROLYZED CORN PROTEIN r11 and HYDROLYZED SOY PROTEIN r12 are not L9 members (the published result names hydrolyzed wheat protein specifically).
POLYQUATERNIUM-4 is NOT an L9 member — the closed list carries Polyquaternium-55 and the PVM/MA-with-Polyquaternium-28 complex, and the list may not be extended by analogy (§5, G10).
DIMETHICONE, AMODIMETHICONE, PANTHENOL and RICINUS COMMUNIS SEED OIL are generic silicone, panthenol and oil: explicitly barred from `formula_plausible` (G10, FS-7, FS-24).
heat_protection_evidence_state.formula_sanity_check: §13.3 rule 2, the `false` / `not_claimed` row: an L9 member is present above the tail but NO C1/C2 heat claim exists. A formula does not manufacture a claim (§5 L9 tail-member rule 2), so `provides_heat_protection` stays `false`, the trace state stays `not_claimed`, and the binary and the trace state do not point in opposite directions. The record routes to review under `l9_member_without_claim` (§14, T17 H8) so a human can decide whether a manufacturer heat source was simply not found.
heat_protection_evidence_state.study_context_limitation: §5 L9 rule 4: McMullen & Jachowicz tested one specific hydrolyzed wheat protein at a defined concentration in a model system, and an INCI list can confirm neither the specific protein nor the concentration. Recorded even though no upgrade is taken.
heat_protection_evidence_state.threshold_reasoning: `claim_only` requires a C1/C2 (or C2_cross_market_verified) heat claim — absent. `formula_plausible` requires that claim PLUS an L9 member above the tail in a plausible film-forming context; §5's rule 3 composes the two conjunctively, and only the L9 half is satisfied. `product_tested` requires an exact-product thermal endpoint meeting §3.2 — none exists (§17.8: the state may be permanently empty).
limitations: Ceiling low (§7.8 summary table) — the ceiling caps the value irrespective of how firmly the claim absence is established.
G10: never grade efficacy, never use a °C figure as a protection level, never let generic silicone/protein/panthenol/oil reach `formula_plausible`.
FS-14: no `heat_protection_max_c` field exists in this model and no °C figure is recorded.
G8: no rinse-out or salon-regime evidence enters this read.

repair_surface_film.anchor: §7.10 `none_visible` — the formula of record carries no member of the closed `candidate` list (cationised protein, silane derivative, silicone quat). Its three proteins are plain, non-cationised hydrolysates, and a non-silicone cationic polymer is explicitly excluded from `candidate`.
repair_surface_film.plain_hydrolysate_note: Mandatory §7.10 trace note: HYDROLYZED WHEAT PROTEIN r10, HYDROLYZED CORN PROTEIN r11 and HYDROLYZED SOY PROTEIN r12 are plain hydrolysates sitting HIGH in the list, all above the r13 marker. What makes a protein an R2 route is cationisation or silane functionalisation, not rank (§7.10 change 2), so none of them qualifies at any position. The note is recorded so the record does not read as if they were missed.
excluded_routes_recorded: POLYQUATERNIUM-4 r16 — a non-silicone cationic polymer, removed from the qualifying list in v0.2 because it rested on a charge-density property G4 forbids inferring. It contributes to PERS and `smoothing_route` only.
AMODIMETHICONE r4 — an amino silicone (`ph_dependent_cationic` in §7.6), not a declared `Silicone Quaternium-x`; the R2 closed list names silicone quats specifically.
PANTHENOL r21 — a fibre-mechanics signal (L6), never an R2 route and never a heat route (§7.10 Panthenol rule, FS-24).
repair_surface_film.candidate_below_tail_check: The `candidate_below_tail` note (§7.10, v0.3) does not fire: it requires a §7.10-QUALIFYING route sitting at or below the marker, and the formula of record contains no qualifying route at any rank. The below-marker discipline on this record attaches to PERS (POLYQUATERNIUM-4), not to R2. `tail_marker_implausible` likewise does not fire — the marker is plausible (§3.1.1 clause 5).
counter_signals: Residual source noise: the demoted loreal-paris.de capture carries HYDROXYPROPYLTRIMONIUM HYDROLYZED WHEAT PROTEIN at its r12, above its own r13 marker — a cationised protein that would read `candidate` and would move the `repair` focus, damage_fit row 3b, `repair_support_level` and `care_direction`. That species is absent from the three-source-confirmed formula of record and the packet characterises that capture as most likely stale or market-mismatched. The value is taken from the primary, with confidence lowered one step and the divergence recorded here rather than the field being blanked.

The C2 manufacturer positioning („repariert Haarschäden effektiv", „Anti-Spliss-Effekt", „Die Längen und die Spitzen werden regeneriert", „mit pflanzlichen Proteinen … angereicherte Haarkur") is repair-led. §9 constraint 3 and §10.2 principle 4 bind: marketing direction never sets the value, and a product sold on protein repair whose only proteins are plain hydrolysates reads exactly as the formula reads.
repair_surface_film.threshold_reasoning: `candidate` requires an identifiable substantive route from the closed list present as architecture in a plausible film context; none of the three routes on the list is present at any rank. `tested` requires exact-product endpoint evidence meeting §3.2 — none. `unknown` is not taken: the formula of record is complete and its protein context is entirely readable; abstaining here would be blanking a field the adjudicated primary can answer, and would carry the answer away from the conservative value rather than toward it (§1.1).
limitations: Ceiling low–moderate; the evidence base is supplier-dominated and molecular-weight figures come from datasheets, not independent measurement (§7.10).
G3: R2 shares M2 with PERS and `care_direction` and is not independent corroboration of either.
Never converts into structural repair, penetration, strength or a diagnosed protein need (§7.10 gates). FS-5, FS-19, FS-24 observed.

architecture.rule: §3.1.2 decision order (anhydrous_serum_or_oil → two_phase → emulsion → microemulsion → aqueous_or_hydroalcoholic_solution → unknown), first match taken. NOT anhydrous: AQUA leads at r1. NOT two_phase: the row requires an unemulsified architecture with no emulsifier and no solubiliser package capable of carrying the load, and BEHENTRIMONIUM CHLORIDE r14 (cationic surfactant), TRIDECETH-6 r15 (nonionic ethoxylate) and the TRIETHANOLAMINE r5 / CARBOMER r24 neutralised system between them supply exactly that capacity. MATCHES `emulsion`, sub-type (b) non-LGN: a nonionic/cationic-surfactant plus polymeric emulsifier system with NO LGN pair — no long-chain fatty alcohol is declared anywhere on the formula of record, so the cationic surfactant has no lamellar partner — carrying a real lipid and silicone phase (ISOPROPYL MYRISTATE r2, DIMETHICONE r3, AMODIMETHICONE r4, RICINUS COMMUNIS SEED OIL r7). `microemulsion` is not reached because `emulsion` matches first, and would fail test (i) in any case: TRIDECETH-6 is the only solubiliser-type material and no glycols sit high in the list, so there is no solubiliser package (§3.1.2, as tightened in v0.3). The `aqueous_or_hydroalcoholic_solution` row is excluded independently, because a real oil/silicone load is present as architecture. Consumed INLINE only — in G0's boundary rationale, in COND's routes and in WT's G9 clauses — and never emitted as a dimension, a confidence band or a projected field (§7.1, T11). G9 binds absolutely: this read may never set WT in either direction, and no part of the WT value above comes from it.
architecture.shake_caution_check: The architecture read does not resolve to `two_phase`, so the §18 „Vor Gebrauch gut schütteln…" string and the §14 two-phase review trigger do not fire (§7.5 G9 clause 3).

records.cautions_de_basis: §18. String 1 is emitted by `weight_potential = high`. String 2 is the buildup caution: §18 keys its row „PERS → `high` + buildup caution", written before T17 widened §8.5's emission rule to the WT limb, and T17 explicitly added no string in v0.4 — so the caution fires under §8.5 while the §18 row's key names only the older limb. Emitting the existing buildup string is the reading §8.6 rule 5 requires (a fired flag's user-facing consequence is the §18 string it already emitted) and the direction §1.1 requires (T17's own rationale: the widening moves the caution toward showing the user more information, never toward a recommendation); the keying discrepancy is recorded here rather than resolved by a lane. String 3 is emitted by EXPO: §18 carries rows for `fragrance_declared` and `no_listed_fragrance_signal` but none for `aromatic_or_allergen_exposure`, and the `fragrance_declared` string is the nearest accurate one — it states only what is declared and asserts nothing about tolerance. NOT emitted: the two-phase shake string (architecture is `emulsion`); the EXPO alcohol string (ISOPROPYL ALCOHOL sits outside §7.12's `Alcohol Denat.`/`Alcohol` enumeration, §17.21); every HEAT string (the trace state is `not_claimed`, which §18 gives no string — „… ist ausgelobt" strings require C1/C2 claim authority and there is no heat claim); every R3 string (`none` emits nothing, §8.3); the LAYER string (§8.4 states no trigger condition); the transfer caution (§18 defines no string for it); the WT `low` string; and „Dazu haben wir keine belastbare Information." — no field on this record projects `unknown`, which is the change the amendment makes most visible to a user.
